# ============================================================
# .github/workflows/ci.yml

name: CI

# This ordinary comment should not appear in Outline.

# === Workflow triggers ===

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

# === Permissions ===

permissions:
  contents: read

# === Jobs ===

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
